subject.title: Feishu plugin: remove dependency on contact:contact.base:readonly for sender name resolution

question: Should Feishu basic inbound message handling be contact-directory-free by default, and what explicit opt-in contract should govern contact-backed display-name and live-directory lookup?
rationale: The code change affects Feishu permission scope, sender attribution, default behavior, and a security-sensitive organization directory access path; automation cannot safely choose that product/security boundary while an overlapping maintainer PR is paused for human review.

options.title: Contact-free default with opt-in
options.body: Default basic inbound messages to no contact-directory calls, use only verified lower-scope metadata or stable ids, and make contact-backed lookup and live directory listing explicit opt-ins.

options.title: Keep current opt-out model
options.body: Preserve resolveSenderNames default true and document the sensitive permission tradeoff, accepting the current security and UX friction.

options.title: Land the narrower PR first
options.body: Resolve the open Feishu display-name PR first for DM fallback behavior, then keep this issue open for the broader contact-free default and live-directory decision.

recommendation.title: Contact-free default with opt-in
recommendation.body: Default basic inbound messages to no contact-directory calls, use only verified lower-scope metadata or stable ids, and make contact-backed lookup and live directory listing explicit opt-ins.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to this issue and owns the overlapping Feishu PR that already touches the display-name path.
